paragraphs: SwimTopia sells web-based swim team management software covering credit card registration, calendar and signups, a custom website, online registration and store, and volunteer management. Meet Maestro is the meet software, which integrates with timing systems, runs swim meets, and collects times and generates reports. Subscribers to the mobile app have heat sheets, push notifications, personalized views and other data. Several product tiers are offered, and all of them include Meet Maestro meet software.

Buyers are swim teams and swim leagues, over two thousand teams and hundreds of leagues by the company's own count. Summer swim teams are the stated focus, with high school programs and year-round clubs named as fits as well. League boards are offered a SwimTopia website for free, regardless of how many of their teams use SwimTopia for team management.

quote.text: Meet Maestro comes with all SwimTopia accounts and can be accessed directly through the SwimTopia interface.
